_comment: Source catalog. 'verified_at' is set only for URLs confirmed on 2026-11-13 to return a valid RSS/Atom document via an external fetch (the build container itself could not reach these hosts). Reliability grades are PROVISIONAL defaults based on source type and ownership, not a measured track record; analysts must review them. News-media licences are marked review_required: headlines, links and short excerpts only until a licence is confirmed. Run `gccintel sources verify` from the deployment environment to re-check reachability and robots.txt.
